themes_detail.label: Electrical System Emergency
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints skyrocketed to 5 this week versus a baseline of 0.2 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 1,900% spike (z-score: 7.18)—suggesting potential widespread electrical hazards or infrastructure failure in Bay Ridge/Dyker Heights that demands immediate investigation.
evidence: 5 electrical complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (z-score: 7.18, high severity)
Represents a statistically significant anomaly indicating potential grid or building-level failure
Electrical hazards pose fire and safety risk to residents
reporting_angles: Interview Con Edison about service disruptions, transformer failures, or grid stress in CD 310
Document affected properties and interview residents about power outages, surges, or damage
Investigate whether aging infrastructure in Bay Ridge is vulnerable to electrical failure

themes_detail.label: Door/Window Damage Wave
themes_detail.summary: Door and window complaints surged to 21 last week versus a 6.0 per-week baseline—a 250% spike (z-score: 4.69)—indicating a possible break-in pattern, storm damage, or structural issue affecting multiple residences in the district.
evidence: 21 door/window complaints LAST WEEK vs. 6.0 weekly average (z-score: 4.69, high severity)
250% increase suggests localized event (weather, criminal activity, or structural failure)
reporting_angles: Cross-reference with NYPD crime reports to determine if this reflects burglary uptick
Investigate whether recent weather or wind events caused structural damage to older Bay Ridge homes
Interview residents in affected blocks about timing and nature of damage (forced entry vs. deterioration)

themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Disposal Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints peaked at 15 two weeks ago—a 532% spike versus the 2.4 per-week baseline (z-score: 4.86)—suggesting a sanitation or pest control breakdown affecting public health and neighborhood conditions.
evidence: 15 dead animal complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 2.4 weekly baseline (z-score: 4.86, high severity)
532% spike indicates concentrated event or systemic sanitation failure
Public health concern; aligns with recurring CB budget request for garbage collection and recycling infrastructure
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Parks and Sanitation to determine if there was a specific incident or delayed removal protocol failure
Investigate whether rat or pest population is exploding in Bay Ridge; tie to broader rodent control efforts
Document specific locations and confirm whether issue has resolved or persists

themes_detail.label: Building Code Violation Surge
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use complaints jumped to 57 three weeks ago—a 407% spike versus 11.2 per-week baseline (z-score: 6.17)—suggesting either illegal conversions, overcrowding, or code enforcement activity concentrated in Bay Ridge properties.
evidence: 57 building/use complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 11.2 weekly baseline (z-score: 6.17, high severity)
407% spike; 425 DOB permits filed in past 90 days suggests active construction/alteration activity
Aligns with recurring CB budget requests for DOB capital resources and enforcement
reporting_angles: Identify which properties triggered the surge; investigate illegal conversion patterns (basements, accessory units)
Interview DOB about compliance enforcement strategy in Bay Ridge during this period
Examine whether recent rezoning proposals (9201 4th Ave, 9818 Fort Hamilton Parkway) triggered speculative alterations

themes_detail.label: Missing Street Signs Problem
themes_detail.summary: Street sign complaints spiked to 5 three weeks ago—a 567% increase from 0.8 per-week baseline (z-score: 6.43)—creating navigation and safety hazards that suggest either vandalism, inadequate DOT maintenance, or weather damage in Bay Ridge.
evidence: 5 missing street sign complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.8 weekly baseline (z-score: 6.43, high severity)
567% spike indicates concentrated event or pattern
Affects pedestrian safety and traffic navigation
reporting_angles: Contact NYC DOT to determine if this reflects vandalism, weather damage, or deferred maintenance
Map affected intersections to identify whether damage is concentrated or dispersed
Document impact on residents, elderly pedestrians, and delivery workers reliant on street signage
